summary.headline: Q1 FY27 revenue rose 49% YoY to INR359.2 crore, but EBITDA margin fell to 21.07% from 26.65%, and FY27 guidance was trimmed to 21-22%.
summary.overview: Revenue from operations was INR359.2 crore (+49% YoY) with EBITDA of INR75.7 crore (+17.9% YoY) and PAT of INR45.2 crore (+6.5% YoY). Management attributed the margin compression to higher raw material costs, a renewables mix, and a step-up in employee cost (about 7% of revenue vs 3-3.5% earlier). Total order book is about INR6,721 crore, split INR3,694 crore water/wastewater and INR3,027 crore renewables and BESS. Management reiterated FY27 revenue guidance of INR2,000 crore and PAT of INR260-270 crore, while lowering the EBITDA margin guidance to 21-22% from 22-24%, and later described a blended 19-20% margin.

segments.name: Water and wastewater treatment
segments.commentary: Order book INR3,694 crore (INR2,696 crore execution, INR998 crore O&M). Q1 revenue approx INR255 crore; management guides EBITDA margin 21-22% and FY27 topline INR1,300 crore from this order book at about 50% conversion.

segments.name: Renewable energy and BESS
segments.commentary: Order book INR3,027 crore (INR1,948 crore execution, INR1,079 crore IPP and O&M). Q1 revenue approx INR104 crore; guided EBITDA margin 15-18%, with execution over 12-18 months.

segments.name: Suyog Urja (wind EPC)
segments.commentary: Q1 revenue INR80 crore; FY27 revenue expectation INR400-450 crore; wind EPC pipeline INR800 crore with a further INR500-600 crore expected; EBITDA margin 15-16%.

guidance_outlook: FY27 revenue guidance maintained at INR2,000 crore; PAT guidance INR260-270 crore (per analyst recap, confirmed by management).
EBITDA margin guidance lowered to 21-22% from the earlier 22-24%; later framed as blended 19-20% (water 21-22%, renewables 15-18%).
Employee cost expected to normalise to 5-5.5% of revenue and finance cost to 3-3.5% during FY27.
FY27 order inflow expected at about INR2,500 crore (about 20% strike rate); INR256 crore won so far.
Quarterly revenue split expected as roughly 20%/20%/20% for Q1-Q3 and about 40% in Q4; BESS NTPC (930 MWh) procurement to start in Q3.
Management stated a bare-minimum growth target of 25-30% a year going forward while maintaining margins.
